items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: Well I listen to Coltrane, I listen to Bird, Dizzy, Horace Silver — you notice only jazz musicians.

ctx.x: What do you put on, who do you listen to at home, if anybody?

Well I listen to Coltrane, I listen to Bird, Dizzy, Horace Silver — you notice only jazz musicians. Yeah, I listen to them very carefully. I don’t try to copy nothing what they’re doing but I listen very careful. If I’m going to use it I take it and turn it around just so much, so that it don’t sound like exactly what this guy’s doing.
Just like all those years ago when your father brought you that sheet music and you started like messing with it.
